text.en:
The name of Sulu Pilot Opportunity School of Fisheries, located at Sanga-Sanga in the
Municipality of Bongao, Province of Tawi-Tawi, is hereby changed to Tawi-Tawi Pilot Opportunity School of

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: March 25, 1982
